description: This file contains TypeScript code for managing OAuth credentials and interactions with keychain and file storage for CLI tools related to agents, including functions for reading, writing, caching, and resolving credential paths for different providers like Claude, Codex, and Minimax.

classes.name: CachedValue
classes.description: Generic cache wrapper for storing credential data with timestamp and source fingerprint.

classes.name: ClaudeCliCredential
classes.description: Type representing OAuth or token credentials for Claude CLI.

classes.name: CodexCliCredential
classes.description: Type representing OAuth credentials for Codex CLI.

classes.name: MiniMaxCliCredential
classes.description: Type representing OAuth credentials for Minimax CLI.

methods.name: resetCliCredentialCachesForTest
methods.description: Resets all credential caches, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: readClaudeCliCredentials
methods.description: Reads Claude CLI credentials from keychain or file.

methods.name: readClaudeCliCredentialsCached
methods.description: Reads cached Claude CLI credentials with TTL support.

methods.name: writeClaudeCliKeychainCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to the macOS keychain for Claude CLI.

methods.name: writeClaudeCliFileCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to a JSON file for Claude CLI.

methods.name: writeClaudeCliCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to keychain or file depending on platform.

methods.name: readCodexCliCredentials
methods.description: Reads Codex CLI credentials from keychain or JSON file.

methods.name: readCodexCliCredentialsCached
methods.description: Reads cached Codex CLI credentials with TTL support.

methods.name: writeCodexCliKeychainCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to the macOS keychain for Codex CLI.

methods.name: writeCodexCliFileCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to a JSON file for Codex CLI.

methods.name: writeCodexCliCredentials
methods.description: Writes OAuth credentials to keychain or file depending on platform.
